title: Opening hours, soft band
description: A heading, a note and a button with directions beside a card listing days and times, on a soft background. Stacks on small screens.

body.label: Introduction
body.description: An invitation to visit or call, in one sentence.

note.placeholder: [Add holiday closures, or remove this line]

actions.label: Button
actions.description: A link to the address on a map (OpenStreetMap, Google Maps…), or to the contact page.

hours.label: Opening hours
hours.description: One line per day, or per run of days with the same hours, in week order: the days, then the times, such as “Monday to Friday: 8:00 – 18:00”.
